"Mulder, why are we here?"

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

You see that, Scully? You always keep me guessing. This is dr. Irving thalbro, age 66, found hanged with his throat cut, his family tucked away and in bed not 40 feet from here. Didn't see or hear anything.

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Except they're the ones that called it in, and there's no evidence whatsoever to link them to the crime.

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Dana Scully

Fox Mulder

Fox Mulder
